500-1018-4923.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
500-1018-4923.description:
Cast Cabal Ritual by paying {1}{B}, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Skullwinder and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Skullwinder tokens enter, they each trigger, returning Cabal Ritual and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3000-3510-3875-4875.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Conspiracy.
3000-3510-3875-4875.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Conspiracy and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Provisioner to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Chatterfang.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

574-1981-2415-4063.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Fleshtaker and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-1981-2415-4063.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

3488-4828-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Benefactor's Draught is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
3488-4828-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
3488-4828-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Katsumasa.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Benefactor's Draught without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Benefactor's Draught, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat from step 2.

628-7187-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Hovel Hurler.
When Hovel Hurler dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

1308-4365-6441-6664-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

803-3413-6446.description:
Activate Silvar by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Arcane Adaptation, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Silvar ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1183-2099-6972.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Pentavus.
When Pentavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3734-5400.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3734-5400.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Synth Infiltrator and Phyrexian Metamorph each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3734-5400.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

670-1619-4142-6152.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-4142-6152.description:
Cast Hostage Taker by paying its mana cost.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Veteran Dungeoneer until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, causing Veteran Dungeoneer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Veteran Dungeoneer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Veteran Dungeoneer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Hostage Taker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Veteran Dungeoneer until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Repeat from step 5.

215-539-4734-7781.description:
Activate Cradle Clearcutter by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Cast Woodcaller Automaton for its prototype cost by paying {2}{G}{G}.
When Woodcaller Automaton enters, it triggers, untapping Cradle Clearcutter
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Woodcaller Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

765-1558-2638-4231-6753.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1558-2638-4231-6753.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

4734-7282-7340.description:
Activate Cradle Clearcutter by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Cradle Clearcutter.
Repeat.

1329-2099-7340.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1329-2099-7340.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard this turn.
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard by paying {U}.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Sewer-veillance Cam.
Sewer-veillance Cam triggers, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

855-1491-2113-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1292-3117-3835-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and putting Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Jace's Erasure triggers, causing you to mill Sensei's Divining Top.
When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

4336-4763-5231--21.description:
Activate the Equipment by paying its equip cost, attaching it to Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, adding {R}.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Koll triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

469-6452.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant or sorcery card in hand with enough mana to cast it.
You have enough mana to cast Insidious Will
469-6452.description:
Cast the additional instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
If Adaptive Training Post had two charge counters on it, it triggers, putting a charge counter on it.
Holding priority, activate Adaptive Training Post by removing three charge counters from it, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn.
Cast Insidious Will by paying its mana cost, targeting the spell cast in step 1.
Adaptive Training Post triggers, copying Insidious Will, with the copy targeting the original Insidious Will.
Resolve the copy of Insidious Will, copying the original Insidious Will, with the copy targeting the original Insidious Will.
Repeat step 5.

5226-5478-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
5226-5478-5720-5721.description:
Activate Lithatog's second ability by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Legendary Artifact Creature with no colored cost

661-3003-3169-4659--50.notablePrerequisites: You are able to cast your commander by paying {0} due to Mycosynth Golem.
661-3003-3169-4659--50.description:
Cast your commander by paying {0} due to Mycosynth Golem.
When your commander enters the battlefield, Sculpting Steel and Genesis Chamber trigger, creating two 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing your commander, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return your commander to the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1006-2178-5367.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1006-2178-5367.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

2232-2983-3806-5093.description:
Cast Gnarled Scarhide by paying {0} due to Ragemonger.
When Gnarled Scarhide enters the battlefield, Sethron and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Sethron trigger, creating a 2/3 Minotaur creature token.
When the Minotaur token enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Gnarled Scarhide to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

2757-3129-5189.notablePrerequisites:
There is a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
You control at least one basic land.
2757-3129-5189.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Saproling, untapping a basic land.
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Saproling, untapping a basic land.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Saproling, putting two +1/+1 counters on Ghave.
Repeat.
On each other iteration, you may skip steps 4-6 to get infinite Saproling creature tokens and mana, or you may optionally get infinite +1/+1 counters and then skip the steps.

2803-3263-3750.notablePrerequisites: Mark of Sakiko attached to a creature with power five or greater that can attack this turn, and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2803-3263-3750.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Mark of Sakiko attached.
The creature triggers, adding at least {5}.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {5}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
If the creature with Mark of Sakiko attached has power six or greater, this combo will net infinite mana.

1258-2366-3293-3577-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor, adding one mana of any color.
Dryad Arbor dies, triggering Abduction, returning Dryad Arbor to the battlefield.
Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning Abduction to the battlefield enchanting Dryad Arbor.
Repeat.

2825-4821-5116.description:
Tap Gilded Lotus for {3} of any color.
Using {2}, tap Elite Arcanist to cast a copy of Dramatic Reversal.
Repeat for infinite mana.

712-3360-4474.description:
Equip Paradise Mantle onto Torchling.
Tap Torchling to add {R}.
Spend that mana to untap Torchling, Wake Thrasher gets +1/+1.
Repeat.
